questions.stem: A direct current of $6 \mathrm{~A}$ is superimposed on an alternating current $I=10 \sin \omega t$ flowing through a wire. The effective value of the resulting current will be
questions.solution: Over a full cycle, $\langle\sin\omega t\rangle=0$ and $\langle\sin^2\omega t\rangle=1/2$. Therefore $I_{\rm rms}=\sqrt{\langle(6+10\sin\omega t)^2\rangle}=\sqrt{36+50}=\sqrt{86}\approx9.27\,\mathrm A$.
